description:

title: Strategy Analyst
description:
Are you passionate about shaping growth strategies that help R&D professionals innovate and commercialize ideas? Do you enjoy turning market insights into strategic action while collaborating with product, commercial, and senior leadership teams? Our technology teams use cutting-edge technologies to build products and systems that advance science and health. We provide our customers with powerful digital solutions, helping them to research the biggest problems facing the world today.
